keys.summary: The language to translate into, as a BCP-47 tag or as a language written out; empty for this session's own language

keys.name: source
keys.summary: The language to translate from; empty to work it out from the text itself

keys.name: profile
keys.summary: How the translation is worded: natural keeps the original's tone; casual, polite and business write it that way

keys.name: model-backend
keys.summary: The account that translates, a backend id or an endpoint:<id>; empty for the one the desktop answers with

keys.name: model
keys.summary: The model that translates; empty for the account's own

keys.name: effort
keys.summary: How hard the model thinks about a translation; empty for the desktop's own setting

domains.summary: Where the desktop forecasts the weather for, and in which units

keys.name: location
keys.summary: Whether the forecast follows where this machine is, or one chosen place

keys.name: place
keys.summary: The chosen place: name, region, country, country_code, latitude and longitude

keys.name: temperature-unit
keys.summary: How temperatures are given; automatic follows the measurement locale

keys.name: speed-unit
keys.summary: How wind speeds are given

keys.name: precipitation-unit
keys.summary: How rain and snow are measured

keys.name: pressure-unit
keys.summary: How air pressure is given

keys.name: distance-unit
keys.summary: How far one can see is given

domains.summary: How the session arranges and presents its windows

keys.name: layout
keys.summary: Whether windows overlap freely or share the display

keys.name: gap-inner
keys.summary: Pixels left between two tiled windows

keys.name: gap-outer
keys.summary: Pixels left between a tiled window and the edge of the display

keys.name: resize-on-border
keys.summary: Whether dragging the edge of a tiled window resizes it

keys.name: scrolling
keys.summary: Whether tiled windows stand in columns on a strip that scrolls sideways instead of sharing out the display

keys.name: focus-outline
keys.summary: Whether the focused tiled window is framed in the accent colour

keys.name: snap
keys.summary: Whether dragging a floating window to an edge or a snap zone arranges it there

keys.name: snap-bar
keys.summary: Whether dragging a window to the top of the display reveals the snap layouts

keys.name: snap-assist
keys.summary: Whether snapping a window offers the other windows for the zones left over

keys.name: snap-resize-together
keys.summary: Whether resizing a snapped window resizes the ones beside it

keys.name: allow-tearing
keys.summary: Whether a fullscreen window that asks for it shows each frame at once, tearing, instead of waiting for the display's refresh
